title: Confusion-trust residual adapter screen
hypothesis: A small residual adapter trained with leave-one-out class prototypes, explicit hardest-confusion separation, and a DINO trust-region improves frozen RBF classification without full backbone fine-tuning.

model.input: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS, L2 normalized

arms.control: Prototype residual adapter without explicit hard-confusion term + RBF SVC C=3
arms.candidate: Confusion-trust residual adapter + RBF SVC C=3

selection_rule.confirmation: If passed, freeze all parameters and test on two new untouched train-only episodes.
